title: Declassified Air Force documents on UFOs at Cold War nuclear sites
place_text: Hanford, Washington; Savannah, South Carolina; Fort Hood, Texas; Los Alamos; Malmstrom; F.E. Warren

tellings.quote: From hundreds of declassified Air Force documents, we now know that UFO sightings were happening across all American nuclear production, missile storage and deployment sites throughout the Cold War,

plain: According to Jesse Michels, hundreds of US Air Force files, once secret and since released to the public, show that UFOs were being reported at every kind of American nuclear site during the Cold War: places that made bomb material, like Hanford in Washington and Savannah in South Carolina, and places that stored or launched missiles, like Fort Hood in Texas, Los Alamos in New Mexico, and the Malmstrom and F.E. Warren missile bases. Michels says it himself, crediting the documents in general without naming any one of them, and puts it this way: "we now know that UFO sightings were happening across all American nuclear production, missile storage and deployment sites throughout the Cold War." If that is right, it would mean something was taking a steady interest in America's nuclear weapons.
